images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished avatar sprite sheet for a minimalist chat application: EIGHT distinct adorable cat portrait icons in ONE image. Canvas exactly 2048x1024, aspect ratio 2:1 landscape. Strict invisible grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, every cell 512x512. Center each cat at the exact center of its cell: x=256,768,1280,1792; y=256,768. Uniform plain warm ivory background #f8f6f1 across the full canvas. No borders, no gridlines, no text, no labels, no logos, no extra symbols. Each portrait includes the entire head with complete ears plus a very short chest, all inside the central 75% of its square, generous identical safe padding. Front-facing natural cat anatomy, distinguishable expressions. Style: high-end handmade soft polymer clay collectible toys, tactile matte clay with tiny sculpted details, rounded delightful shapes, restrained understated charm, soft studio lighting, no hard shadows. Eight cats in exact reading order: TOP LEFT ragdoll with fluffy cream-white fur, chocolate ears, blue eyes and gentle expression; TOP SECOND Maine coon with gray-brown fur, prominent ear tufts and wise serious face; TOP THIRD Siamese with cream fur, dark brown face mask and large dark ears, blue eyes and playful expression; TOP RIGHT Turkish van with white fur and warm orange patches around ears/crown, calm face. BOTTOM LEFT round-faced blue-gray domestic shorthair CAT, contemplative; BOTTOM SECOND Chinese brown tabby with bold tabby stripes and green eyes, alert; BOTTOM THIRD golden Bengal with small rosette markings, curious; BOTTOM RIGHT golden chinchilla with round golden coat, creamy muzzle and emerald eyes, quietly confident. Cohesive scale and lighting across all eight. The sheet will be mechanically split into 8 equal squares: no part of any cat may cross its cell. Beautiful clear readable facial features at tiny avatar size.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a professional consistent collection of EIGHT CAT CHAT AVATARS in a perfectly aligned 4 column by 2 row contact sheet, 2048x1024 landscape 2:1. STYLE MUST BE unmistakably handmade needle-felted WOOL PLUSH TOYS, NOT real cats and NOT realistic fur. Simplified round egg-shaped felt faces, tiny black glass bead pupils in colored wool irises, stubby triangle felt ears, short embroidered yarn whiskers, visible loose wool fibers and fuzzy brushed felt material, miniature handcrafted tactile charm. Their entire heads and tiny rounded chest bibs, no full bodies. Extraordinarily charming and sophisticated product photography of actual handmade wool craft dolls. Soft warm ivory backdrop same throughout, evenly lit, subtle soft shadow only. Strict invisible grid of 8 identical squares: center cats at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% horizontally and 25%,75% vertically. Each doll stays inside central 70% of its cell with generous whitespace, complete ears never cropped. NO text, NO labels, NO logos, NO borders, NO visible grid lines, NO accessories or extra objects. All cats face directly forward. Exact reading order: (1) Ragdoll: cream-white fluffy wool, chocolate ears and cheeks, blue eyes, sweet gentle face; (2) Maine Coon: gray-brown wool, angular broad muzzle, clear felt ear tufts, serious wise expression; (3) Siamese: cream wool body, dark chocolate mask and large dark ears, bright blue eyes, mischievous little smile; (4) Turkish Van: white wool with asymmetrical ginger patches on crown and ears, gentle calm face. Bottom row (5) blue-gray shorthair cat, round squishy face, amber eyes, tiny mouth; (6) brown Chinese tabby, felt dark stripes on forehead, green eyes, alert; (7) warm golden Bengal, distinct tiny dark brown rosette patches, green eyes, curious smile; (8) golden chinchilla, round golden wool head, cream muzzle and chest, emerald eyes. Consistent simplified handmade toy design language and consistent doll size. No photorealistic cat anatomy or long realistic whiskers.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a beautiful hand-painted WATERCOLOR illustrated collection of EIGHT CAT PORTRAIT AVATARS arranged precisely in 4 columns x 2 rows on a single 2048x1024 landscape canvas, 2:1. The art MUST look like delicate watercolor on cold-pressed ivory paper, visible pigment blooms, transparent washes, soft uneven painted edges, a few fine loose sepia pencil marks. NOT 3D, NOT realistic photography, NOT digital airbrush. Sophisticated gentle picture book cat characters with simplified expressive faces, slightly oversized round heads, tiny shoulders, subtle asymmetry and charming personality. Quiet restrained earthy palette, powder blue eyes, ochre fur, cream paper; no glossy eyes or photographic detail. Lots of clear white ivory paper surrounding each portrait. No painted backdrop blobs, no text, no labels, no logos, no borders, no gridlines, no flowers, stars or props. Each complete cat head including ears and a short chest is centered in an equal square cell; maximum occupied size 74% of each square, never crosses a cell boundary. Centerpoints x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y=25%,75%. Exact cats in reading order: TOP 1 a gentle cream-white Ragdoll with brown ears and delicate brown cheeks, blue eyes; TOP 2 wise gray-brown Maine Coon, strong triangular silhouette and distinct long ear tufts, thoughtful stern eyes; TOP 3 lively Siamese cream body, deep brown face mask and large dark ears, blue eyes, curious tilt; TOP 4 serene Turkish Van white with asymmetric orange crown patches, calm amber eyes. BOTTOM 1 a round blue-gray shorthair CAT, amber eyes and a tiny serious face; BOTTOM 2 alert Chinese brown tabby with brown forehead stripes and green eyes; BOTTOM 3 playful golden Bengal with rosette marks and green eyes; BOTTOM 4 round golden chinchilla with creamy muzzle and bib, green eyes, dignified smile. Consistent illustration style and portrait scale. Entire image is a clean avatar sheet designed for splitting into eight squares.
